subject: keyboard-framework
text: - A falsy Dioxus value (Bool false, Text `"false"`, Int 0, Float 0.0, None) of one of the bridge's 28 boolean attributes — upstream's private `is_bool_attr` predicate, a closed `matches!` set, since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship, which retired the bridge's own 27-name `BOOLEAN_ATTRIBUTES` list and left `mutation_writer.rs` byte-identical to upstream's at `434e0661`; `disabled`, `checked`, `hidden`, `readonly`, `required`, `multiple`, `selected`, `open`, `autofocus` and `inert` among them — removes the attribute, on the dynamic and the static template attribute path alike, so an enabled Dioxus control does not match `:disabled` and an element rendered `hidden: false` carries no `hidden` attribute, is laid out and stays in the accessibility tree and the snapshot, while a truthy `hidden` still excludes it (§4); a truthy value of a listed name is still written, and an attribute outside the list holding `false` (`aria-hidden`, a `data-` attribute) is still written as `"false"`; a framework-written `inert: false` is removed — `inert` the 28th name `dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs` reads since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness — while a truthy `inert` takes focusability, hits and the tree away from its subtree (Focus order above; §6 Visibility and hit-testing; ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) and Tab reaches the buttons under `inert: false` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:752-779; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:68-194; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:439-475; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_disabled.rs:24-39; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:57-80; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:130-150; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:173-208) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md and, for the 28-name predicate, escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md

text: - seven_guis CRUD: since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states the person rows are `option`s of a `listbox` by `role` attribute and are not focusable (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:58; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:96-97 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md); since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness the list `crud-list` takes `tabindex="0"` and an `onkeydown` — the third CRUD Tab stop — and, focused, ArrowDown selects the next visible row (the first when none is selected), ArrowUp the previous, Home the first and End the last, each setting the selection and the two fields as a row's click does, a key at the end of the list or ArrowUp with no row selected changing nothing; the tree's focus is the list, never the option — the builder reads no `aria-activedescendant`, so an assistive technology learns the current row only from its `selected` reading — recorded, not closed: an `aria-activedescendant` read in the builder, or a roving focus, is SC 4.1.2 work outside the tier-0 target, kept unread on the founder's F2 «Оставить записанным (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed by the overseer as his chosen option label) and pinned by `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_active_descendant_unread.rs:39-81) (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:60-87; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:92; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:173-179; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:657-717) — the operator's decision, as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the list is named `People` by `aria-label` (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:59 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md)
